decisions.reason: Adding door-wall offset dimensions and the Unit 3 bathroom width annotation does not change the Unit 3 door position or kitchen-counter clearance constraint.
The source requests display of the existing Unit 3 bathroom width, not a change to its physical width, shower location, or fixture layout.
Dimension annotations for bathroom doors and bathroom width do not alter the Unit 3 kitchen configuration or its bathroom-door clearance constraint.
The annotation additions do not resolve the existing fixture-fit ambiguity or change the Unit 1 ensuite spatial arrangement.
Adding bathroom-door wall-offset annotations does not change the Unit 2 bathroom door's centered position or other layout state.
The source concerns dimension annotations on the plan and does not change the contents or separation of the furnished-layout drawing.
The detailed plan remains an AutoCAD deliverable; the annotation details are independently represented by the source Requirement and do not alter this candidate's deliverable or format attributes.
The later request for detailed dimension annotations does not revise the purpose or required content of the initial concept sketch.

The source Requirement's annotation changes do not alter the Unit 1 door type; the separate same-message request to replace the sliding door with a normal hinged door is already captured by this candidate's existing MODIFY.
Door-offset and bathroom-width annotations do not change bathroom drainage locations, drain-connection targets, or the unresolved drainage scope.
The requested annotations do not move, add, or remove any partition wall.
The annotation additions do not change the common bathroom's inclusion, shower placement, completion, or relationship to the ensuite.
